a: Doping adds impurities to control semiconductor charge carriers.
P-N junctions are the basis of diodes.
LEDs emit light when electrons recombine across a junction.
Solar cells convert light into electrical energy.
Transistors can act as electronic switches.
CMOS logic uses complementary MOSFETs for low power digital circuits.
Half-life is characteristic of each radioisotope.
Binding energy per nucleon relates to nuclear stability.
Accelerators boost charged particles to high energies for research.
The cosmic microwave background is leftover radiation from the early universe.
